verdict.rationale: Anrok can sync transactions from billing systems (anrok-docs-33). Its dashboard shows a world exposure map with sales data by jurisdiction and threshold tracking (anrok-docs-17), and it markets alerts before you owe (anrok-docs-20). This covers jurisdiction-level exposure visibility, but nothing shows a backdated liability analysis. Missing for 10: explicit historical/backdated transaction import, an estimated past-due liability calculation, penalty and interest estimates per jurisdiction, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
